notes.title: Update 1.7: improved visuals
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31129941/059f81555d1164de9bf400971c93f0f2472fc1d9.jpg[/img]

Dear Nirvana Pilots,
we are happy to bring you this update with some popular demand changes to improve scene readability in races!

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Obstacles are made more visible by coloring their front;
[*] Baseline noise/glitching disabled;
[*] Losing Nirvana Sync during races won't trigger cosmetic effects (noise/glitching) anymore;
[*] The ultraship has now a toon style outline.
[/list]

Enjoy, and don't forget to leave a honest review here on Steam!

notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31129941/d1a4a75e3c84afcb3b94a973403cb5028154354b.png[/img]

Hey Nirvana Pilots,
update 1.5 is now live, bringing you a lot of sauce!

[b]Your requests:[/b]
[*] [b]The camera is now angled in a different way to improve visibility![/b] This very requested feature is now enabled by default, but you can go back to the original camera (called "Racing Camera") in the Settings. Let us know how you like it!
[*] The game now supports more resolutions and can be played in Windowed Mode. Check Settings.
[/list]

[b]Other Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added fps counter (activate it in Settings)
[*] The game now captures a single screen and doesn't obscure secondary monitors.
[*] OSX version default execution mode is now fullscreen.
[/list]

[b]Balance:[/b]
[list]
[*] Jump is 10% stronger.
[*] Story mode difficulty has been lowered: you can now access the final exam with 4 wins out of the 9 training races.
[*] The amount of glitching when Nirvana Sync decreases has been lowered.
[/list]

[b]Bugfix:[/b]
[list]
[*] We had a bug when restart was triggered from a gamepad.
[*] The ultraship would fall at the end of Race 8.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2
Update 1.2
Update 1.01
notes.content:
Hello Nirvana Pilots,
we just released the first update for the game!

[b]What changed:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]improvement:[/b] jump improved to have a more consistent feeling and predictable
[*][b]improvement:[/b] restart screen at death is faster
[*][b]bugfix:[/b] after crashing, you could turn on the engines before pressing restart and cause the restart screen to flicker
[*][b]bugfix:[/b] after crashing the spaceship would keep moving for 1 second
[/list]

[b]What's next[/b]
We are currently testing MAC and Linux builds, and update 1.02 is already in the works. Here's what you can expect:
[list]
[*][b]bufgix:[/b] P doesn't pause the game
[*][b]bugfix:[/b] game icon doesn't show and is replaced by Unity icon
[*][b]bugfix/improvement:[/b] brake reworked
[*][b]improvement:[/b] add the possibility to pause the game by pressing ESC
[*][b]improvement:[/b] show controls in Settings
[*][b]improvement:[/b] possibility to enable CRT/glitch filters for all the game (currently it works only on the menus).
[/list]

Keep racing!
The Dev9k Team
